exposure: Mode of birth (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: The participants included 52,399 women and 53,236 newborns whose data were recorded in the Georgian Birth Registry in 2016.
finding: The Georgian Birth Registry achieved 93.9% completeness in its first year (2016), reporting a mean gestational age of 271.3 days, a 43.5% Caesarean section rate, and a mean birth weight of 3262 g, but noted discrepancies with official statistics leading to inaccurate perinatal mortality rates.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered by Caesarean section had a lower gestational age and lower birth weight compared to those delivered vaginally.
